name: Western Yilgarn NL
summary: Western Yilgarn NL, an Australian company incorporated in 2005 and headquartered in North Perth, prospects for minerals in Australia and the Solomon Islands, including nickel, copper, platinum group elements, titanium-vanadium, iron, gold, bauxite and tantalite. It fully owns the Darling Range project northeast of Perth and holds stakes in three platinum group element exploration projects.
